svg.title: Music editor song tab — mixer (proposal)
svg.desc: The song tab with the Mixer panel: one strip per track plus master, each with the instrument slot, VST3 insert slots, pan, volume fader, mute/solo and a peak meter; a plugin's own editor window opens from the helper process.
svg.text: Proposal mockup — sizes and spacing indicative. Plugin GUIs are drawn by each plugin, in the helper's own windows.
